verdict.rationale: Close documents creating leads via the REST API and an official MCP server with write scopes, so an agent can create the record and write lead/account data. Nothing in the pack shows automatic company-data enrichment or lead-owner assignment; the `assign_to` changelog entry covers phone numbers, not leads. missing for 10: documented lead owner/assignee field via API or MCP, company-data enrichment capability, an end-to-end agent workflow example, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent enrich a new lead end-to-end via the API or MCP server — creating the record, filling company data, and assigning an owner

citations.quote: Push leads, contacts, activities, and custom data into Close from your website or other systems via the REST API.
Give Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other tools direct access to Close data via the MCP server — no code required.
mcp.write_safe — can read and write data
You can think of a Lead in Close like both a "lead" and "account" in the terminology of some other CRMs.
